def test_all_prefixes():
    # Basic case
    assert all_prefixes("abc") == ["a", "ab", "abc"]

    # Single character
    assert all_prefixes("a") == ["a"]

    # Empty string
    assert all_prefixes("") == []

    # Longer string
    assert all_prefixes("hello") == ["h", "he", "hel", "hell", "hello"]

    # String with spaces
    assert all_prefixes("a b") == ["a", "a ", "a b"]

    # Result count equals string length
    s = "prefix"
    result = all_prefixes(s)
    assert len(result) == len(s)

    # Last prefix is the full string
    assert result[-1] == s

    # Each prefix extends the previous one
    for i in range(1, len(result)):
        assert result[i] == result[i - 1] + s[i - 1]

    # Repeated characters
    assert all_prefixes("aaa") == ["a", "aa", "aaa"]

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_all_prefixes()
